## browser-research-mcp

4 tools · [source](../mcp-servers/browser-research-mcp)

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `search_web` | Search the web using SearXNG or browser-based search. Returns title, url, snippet. Use SearXNG first — it is local and fast. Search snippets are NOT final evidence; agents must call extract_page before making source-backed claims. |
| `extract_page` | Open a public URL with Playwright Chromium, extract readable text, and optionally save a screenshot. Removes nav, footer, scripts, styles. Use this before making any source-backed claim. |
| `save_evidence` | Save extracted evidence to disk as both JSON and Markdown files. Use after extract_page to preserve findings for later reference. |
| `competitor_scan` | Scan for competitors related to a product idea. Returns candidate sources — agents must call extract_page before using findings as evidence. Does not invent competitor features. |

## security-mcp

8 tools · [source](../mcp-servers/security-mcp)

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `run_dependency_scan` | Scan project dependencies for known vulnerabilities using npm audit, pnpm audit, pip-audit, and trivy. Auto-detects project type. |
| `scan_secrets` | Scan codebase for hardcoded secrets, API keys, tokens, passwords, and private keys using gitleaks and 25+ regex patterns. |
| `scan_code_security` | Static analysis of source code for insecure patterns: eval, SQL injection, XSS, path traversal, unsafe deserialization, and more. |
| `analyze_auth_flows` | Analyze authentication logic: detect missing auth middleware, hardcoded tokens, insecure session handling, and weak algorithms. |
| `check_api_security` | Check API security: missing auth, CORS misconfiguration, information disclosure, improper error handling, missing validation. |
| `run_container_scan` | Scan container images or Dockerfiles for vulnerabilities using trivy filesystem scan. |
| `generate_security_report` | Generate a comprehensive Markdown security report aggregating all scan findings for a feature/story. |
| `save_security_evidence` | Save security scan evidence as JSON + Markdown for traceability MCP integration. |

## test-automation-mcp

20 tools · [source](../mcp-servers/test-automation-mcp)

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `run_uat_browser_session` | Run screen-level UAT in a real browser with per-step assertions, screenshots, and support for headless or visible-browser execution. |
| `run_uat_dev_session` | Run UAT in DEV mode using the user's real Chrome browser (via mcp-chrome). Browser window is visible so you can see test execution live. Requires mcp-chrome extension to be connected. Use this instead of run_uat_browser_session for interactive dev/UAT debugging. |
| `run_e2e_test` | Execute an end-to-end browser test with sequential steps. Supports navigation, clicks, typing, waits, and assertions. |
| `capture_screenshot` | Navigate to a URL and capture a full-page screenshot saved to evidence storage. |
| `run_visual_regression` | Compare a current page screenshot against a baseline image and report pixel differences. |
| `analyze_ui` | Extract UI elements (buttons, forms, navigation, inputs) from a page and identify missing labels or inconsistencies. |
| `check_accessibility` | Run axe-core accessibility analysis on a page and return violations with severity and recommendations. |
| `test_user_flow` | Execute a multi-step user flow with UX evidence capture. Similar to run_e2e_test but saves enriched UX evidence. |
| `generate_test_report` | Aggregate all test results, screenshots, and logs into a structured markdown report saved to evidence storage. |
| `save_test_evidence` | Persist structured test evidence (JSON + markdown) linked to a traceability entity ID. |
| `snapshot_page` | Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page as a structured tree. Better than screenshot for understanding page structure. |
| `inspect_network` | Capture all network requests and responses for a page. Navigate to URL and get full request/response details. |
| `inspect_network_request` | Get full details (headers and body) of a single network request by index from inspect_network output. |
| `get_console_logs` | Capture browser console messages (log, warn, error, info, debug). Navigate to URL and collect all console output. |
| `verify_element` | Verify an element with a given role and accessible name is visible on the page. |
| `verify_text` | Verify specific text is visible on the current page. Prefer verify_element when possible. |
| `verify_value` | Verify the value of a form element (input, select, checkbox, etc.). |
| `debug_highlight` | Show a persistent highlight overlay around an element on the page for visual debugging. |
| `debug_trace_start` | Start Playwright trace recording for the current page. Browser must already be launched. Use debug_trace_stop to end. |
| `debug_trace_stop` | Stop Playwright trace recording and save the trace file. |

## traceability-mcp

11 tools · [source](../mcp-servers/traceability-mcp)

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `record_entity` | Create or update a local trace entity. If externalSystem + externalId are provided, upserts by external reference. |
| `link_entities` | Create a trace link between two entities. Prevents duplicate identical links. |
| `add_evidence` | Add an evidence record against a trace entity. |
| `get_trace` | Return entity, linked entities, links, evidence, and gap analysis for an entity. Supports upstream/downstream tracing. |
| `generate_trace_report` | Generate an audit-ready traceability report as markdown or JSON. Saved to TRACEABILITY_REPORT_DIR. |
| `sync_from_jira` | Pull Jira issues into local cache. Maps Epic → epic, Story → story, Task → story, Bug → risk. Creates trace links for parent/child relationships. |
| `sync_to_jira` | Push local entity updates to Jira. By default updates existing issues only. Set createIfMissing=true to create new Jira issues. |
| `sync_from_confluence` | Pull Confluence pages into local cache as research/decision entities. |
| `publish_trace_report_to_confluence` | Generate a trace report and publish/update it as a Confluence page. Only updates pages created by this MCP unless parentPageId is specified. |
| `search_trace` | Search local cache by title, description, external ID, or URL. |
| `sync_all` | Run full Jira and Confluence sync. Writes sync_log records. Returns summary. |

## ux-intelligence-mcp

10 tools · [source](../mcp-servers/ux-intelligence-mcp)

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `ux_generate_design_system` | Generate a complete design system for a product type. Returns pattern, style, colors, typography, effects, anti-patterns, and a pre-delivery checklist. |
| `ux_search_guidelines` | Search UX guidelines by keyword, priority, or category. Returns ranked results with checks and anti-patterns. |

| `ux_get_anti_patterns` | Get anti-patterns to avoid for a specific industry or design style. |
| `ux_get_stack_guidelines` | Get framework-specific implementation guidelines for UI components. Supports 15 stacks: react, next, vue, nuxt, svelte, astro, html-tailwind, shadcn-ui, angular, laravel, swiftui, jetpack-compose, react-native, flutter. |

| `ux_list_styles` | List all available design styles with descriptions. Optionally filter by category. |

## web-downloader-mcp

4 tools · [source](../mcp-servers/web-downloader-mcp)

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `download_web_content` | Download content from any web URL. Supports text, HTML, JSON, images, PDFs, and other file types. Saves to local filesystem with safety controls. |
| `fetch_web_page_info` | Get metadata about a web page without downloading full content. Uses HTTP HEAD request to check status, content type, and size. |
| `fetch_and_extract_html` | Download an HTML page and extract its title, text content, links, images, and meta tags. Safer than full download for research purposes. |
| `get_downloader_info` | Show current downloader configuration: allowed domains, max file size, timeout, blocked extensions, download directory. |
